verdict.rationale: llamafile is itself an official command-line executable. It has a documented `--cli` mode that answers a supplied prompt, a first-party CLI arguments reference, and a community user praising its CLI interface. missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable/structured (e.g. JSON) output, and documentation of scripting or agent-oriented automation patterns for AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: If you add the `--cli` argument to a llamafile, you will run a CLI version of the model that answers to whatever you provide as a prompt
llamafile --server --help ... HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
The llamafile UX (CLI interface and web server with chat) is great
